title.narrative: Integrated Multi-Sector Humanitarian Assistance to support Conflict-Impacted Communities in the Amhara Region

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtAmidst the humanitarian crisis unfolding in the Amhara Region, specifically within the North Wello and North Gondar zones, Welthungerhilfe (WHH) is leading a collaborative effort alongside the Organization for Relief and Development in Amhara (ORDA). With a robust presence and extensive experience in the area, WHH and ORDA are uniquely positioned to address the pressing humanitarian needs and response priorities arising from insecurity, protracted displacement, disease outbreaks, and drought impacts of multi-crisis affecting the region's communities.ltbrgtThe project intervention aims to mitigate the multifaceted challenges faced by over 25,000 vulnerable individuals, including the severe impact of ongoing conflict-driven displacement, drought, and escalating food insecurity. Leveraging their expertise and ongoing resilience programs, WHH and ORDA will focus on key sectoral interventions such as Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) and Emergency Shelter and Non-Food Item (NFI) provision.ltbrgtWHH's commitment to localized aid is exemplified through its collaboration with ORDA, ensuring that interventions are community-driven, culturally sensitive, and sustainable. By empowering local partners and building upon existing resilience programs, WHH aims to maximize the impact of humanitarian assistance and foster long-term resilience within affected communities.ltbrgtThe humanitarian crisis in the Amhara Region, particularly in the North Wello and North Gondar zones, is characterized by frequent conflict, widespread food insecurity, malnutrition, and limited access to essential services. The convergence of conflict, drought, and economic instability has exacerbated the vulnerability of already marginalized populations, leaving them in urgent need of lifesaving support.ltbrgtIn light of these challenges, the project will prioritize the delivery of emergency relief, shelter and NFI support, and WASH services to mitigate the immediate impacts of the crisis. Additionally, WHH and ORDA will work collaboratively to minimize vulnerabilities and build community resilience to withstand shocks.ltbrgtWith a strong foundation of local partnerships, expertise, and a comprehensive approach to addressing the humanitarian crisis, WHH and ORDA are poised to make a meaningful difference in the lives of those affected, particularly in the Adi Arkay, Abrhajira/Mirab Armacho, and Raya Kobo woredas, as well as other parts of the region as necessary. EHF/OCHA reserve allocation support will enable the WHH-led consortium to deliver vital assistance, ensure immediate response, and restore hope to communities in need. If this consortium secures the requested funding, the project can make a lasting impact and ensure that no one is left behind in their time of greatest need.ltbrgtlt/pgt
